description: Filenames the loader refuses to treat as locales at all, each failing a DIFFERENT clause of isLanguageTag (LocalizedStringLoader.java:1649): root passes Locale.Builder but is not CldrLocaleData.isKnownLanguageTag; en-ANT builds to the extlang-promoted 'ant' and is likewise not known; i-enochian IS a known tag but builds to x-i-enochian, whose primary language is empty and which is not explicitly undetermined. One valid file proves the load still succeeds around them. Load-only.
